reproduction.rationale: Both paper_data and paper_data_author_code must retain the original CSI1 Table 1 panel, permitted query/fMRI observations, full matched neural-control suite and common cumulative budgets, with only author code added. Complete 2,095-query/native-data and source-code delivery manifests, original checkpoint/domain exposure, baseline parser/pipeline identity, independent granular-output verification and matched participant runtime are absent. The accepted scorer consumes declared traces; it neither prepares authentic inputs nor enforces a paired episode. No protocol hash or availability is invented.
